scene: The kettle chime summons a tea vendor offering glowing brews.
picture: Flat side view. On the far left sits a low wooden stall counter with a steaming violet cup. In the lilac headscarf and mustard coat, the player stands beside the counter facing right. In the centre, a jovial vendor holds a tray of phosphorescent yellow biscuits. On the far right, a striped calico cat sits near a stone archway.
shown: A steaming violet cup sitting on the vendor counter on the far left.
A tray of phosphorescent yellow biscuits resting on the counter in the centre.
A striped calico cat sitting beside a stone archway on the far right.
